gates.name: No institutional investor yet
gates.rule: Pass only with verified pre-cutoff evidence of founders' money, friends/family, grants/prizes of any amount, or angels totalling <= approximately EUR150k and no institutional investor. Fail for a pre-cutoff VC fund, equity-taking accelerator, priced/announced round, or >EUR150k angels. FUNDED_BEFORE/EXCLUDE_NOT_FIRST or an equity-round flag require dated investor/type evidence before failing; FUNDED_LATER/FUNDED_WITHIN are future outcomes and must not exclude. Unknown angel size, undated round, UNKNOWN, NO_FUNDING_FOUND, or insufficient investor evidence -> unknown/review; absence of a found round is not proof of passing.

gates.name: Not in HTGF portfolio
gates.rule: Pass if explicitly not in HTGF portfolio at cutoff; fail if already in portfolio at cutoff; missing or current-only/undated portfolio evidence -> unknown/review.

gates.name: German seat or operating base
gates.rule: Pass for explicit German registered seat or operating base in historical text/register evidence; fail only for verified absence of both. Legal form alone is insufficient; missing/ambiguous geographic evidence -> unknown/review.

gates.name: Alive (not closed, insolvent or acquired)
gates.rule: Fail for EXCLUDE_ACQUISITION only if acquisition preceded cutoff; pass only with affirmative dated operating evidence and no closure/insolvency/acquisition at cutoff. Other funding statuses do not establish survival; missing dates or survival evidence -> unknown/review. Closure and insolvency are not directly collected.

gates.name: Independent (not corporate-owned)
gates.rule: Fail for explicit evidence that this startup is corporate-owned at cutoff; pass for verified independence. A parent-company mention alone may describe subsidiaries or partners and requires review; absent or ambiguous ownership evidence -> unknown/review.

gates.name: Commercial (not e.V., gGmbH, student club or pure research)
gates.rule: Fail for e.V./e. V., gGmbH, student club, or pure research without a commercial venture; pass for verified commercial company activity; blank/ambiguous legal form or business purpose -> unknown/review.

gates.name: Investable sector (not consulting, agency, retail, real estate, gambling or crypto token)
gates.rule: Pass for explicit investable product/technology sector; fail for consulting, agency, retail, real estate, gambling or crypto-token business. Classify historical description; missing/ambiguous business model -> unknown/review. External relevance_v2 categories deep_tech/digital_tech/life_science can guide review but are not dataset columns; non_tech/unclear alone do not establish a fail.

gates.name: Not noise (not hobby, student assignment or company-less open source)
gates.rule: Fail for explicit hobby, student assignment or company-less open-source project; pass for verified startup activity; missing entity evidence alone is not a fail, and ambiguous company intent -> unknown/review.

gates.name: Age <= 3 years
gates.rule: Pass if observed age is between 0 and 36 months inclusive at cutoff; fail if >36 months; blank/invalid age -> unknown/review. Website age is a proxy and needs review if venture founding age differs.

gates.name: Active in the last 90 days
gates.rule: Pass for verified operating/shipping activity within 90 days before cutoff; fail for verified inactivity throughout that window; unknown/review because dated operating activity is not collected. Website capture/certificate dates do not establish activity.

gates.name: Not faked (no star bursts, new-account stars or bought upvotes)
gates.rule: Pass after verified engagement-authenticity checks; fail for confirmed star bursts, new-account stars or bought upvotes; unknown/review because engagement-authenticity evidence is not collected.

gates.name: More than 25 people (review flag)
gates.rule: At cutoff, <=25 verified people -> pass/no flag; >25 -> review flag, not exclusion; missing size -> unknown/review. Current LinkedIn size is review-only and cannot establish historical size without dated corroboration.
